issues.description: The problem statement refers to a function named `_detect_errors` (described as taking measurements and checks and returning a binary array where 1 indicates no error), while both the template and the solution define the function as `detect_errors` (no leading underscore). This identifier mismatch between the problem text and the code can confuse students about which function to implement or tests to target.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent identifier across artifacts. Either update the problem statement to refer to `detect_errors(...)` (preferred to match template/solution), or rename the template and solution function to `_detect_errors(...)`. Also ensure tests and example usage reference the same name.
